```{=html}
<style>
.w122-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w122-dd .w122-buckets { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w122-dd .w122-bucket {
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  padding: 8px; min-height: 150px; cursor: pointer;
}
.w122-dd .w122-bucket h5 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 0.95rem; text-align: center; font-weight: 700; }
.w122-dd .w122-bucket.w122-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w122-dd .w122-pool {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w122-dd .w122-item {
  display: block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: grab;
  user-select: none; border: 1.5px solid #d81e2e; color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem;
  margin: 3px 0; text-align: center;
}
.w122-dd .w122-pool .w122-item { margin: 0; }
.w122-dd .w122-item.w122-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w122-dd .w122-item.w122-right { border-color: #2e7d32; border-width: 2px; }
.w122-dd .w122-item.w122-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; border-width: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #d81e2e inset; }
.w122-dd .w122-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w122-dd button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w122-dd .w122-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w122-dd .w122-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w122-dd .w122-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w122-dd .w122-note { font-size: 0.78rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.7; }
.w122-dd .w122-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w122-dd iw" id="w122-dd">
  <div class="w122-pool" aria-label="occurrences to classify"></div>
  <div class="w122-buckets">
    <div class="w122-bucket" data-cat="event"><h5>Event</h5></div>
    <div class="w122-bucket" data-cat="incident"><h5>Incident</h5></div>
    <div class="w122-bucket" data-cat="breach"><h5>Breach</h5></div>
  </div>
  <div class="w122-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w122-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w122-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w122-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w122-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w122-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w122-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    An <em>event</em> is any observable occurrence, most of them benign and simply
    logged; an <em>incident</em> violates security policy or threatens
    confidentiality, integrity or availability and demands a response; a
    <em>breach</em> is a successful penetration or circumvention of controls leading
    to unauthorised access or extraction of data, and may trigger legal obligations
    to notify — see <a href="#def-incident">the definition of event, incident and
    breach</a> in <a href="#sec-12-events-incidents-breaches">the section on events,
    incidents and breaches</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w122-dd');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w122-pool');
  const buckets = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w122-bucket')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w122-msg');
  const ITEMS = [
    { id: 'i0', cat: 'incident', text: 'An occurrence violates security policy and demands a response' },
    { id: 'i1', cat: 'event',    text: 'A user logs in successfully; the occurrence is benign and simply logged' },
    { id: 'i2', cat: 'breach',   text: 'Controls are circumvented and data is extracted without authorisation' },
    { id: 'i3', cat: 'event',    text: 'Any observable occurrence, most of them harmless' },
    { id: 'i4', cat: 'breach',   text: 'A successful penetration that may trigger legal obligations to notify' },
    { id: 'i5', cat: 'incident', text: 'An occurrence threatens the availability of a system and must be handled' }
  ];
  let picked = null;

  function makeItem(it) {
    const c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'w122-item';
    c.textContent = it.text;
    c.dataset.id = it.id;
    c.dataset.cat = it.cat;
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement !== pool) { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); return; }
      if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
      unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w122-picked');
      buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.add('w122-armed'));
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', it.id));
    return c;
  }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w122-picked');
    picked = null;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w122-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w122-item').forEach(i => i.classList.remove('w122-right', 'w122-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w122-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(bucket, item) { bucket.appendChild(item); clearMarks(); }
  buckets.forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(b, picked); unpick(); } });
    b.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    b.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const item = root.querySelector('.w122-item[data-id="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
      if (item) { place(b, item); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const item = root.querySelector('.w122-item[data-id="' + e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') + '"]');
    if (item) { pool.appendChild(item); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w122-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0;
    const unplaced = pool.querySelectorAll('.w122-item').length;
    buckets.forEach(b => {
      b.querySelectorAll('.w122-item').forEach(i => {
        i.classList.remove('w122-right', 'w122-wrong');
        if (i.dataset.cat === b.dataset.cat) { i.classList.add('w122-right'); right++; }
        else { i.classList.add('w122-wrong'); wrong++; }
      });
    });
    if (right === ITEMS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — logged, handled, or notified: the classification sets the response.'; msg.className = 'w122-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (unplaced > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + unplaced + ' occurrence(s) still unsorted.'; msg.className = 'w122-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red items are on the wrong level of the scale. Re-read the three definitions and retry.'; msg.className = 'w122-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w122-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    root.querySelectorAll('.w122-item').forEach(c => {
      const bucket = buckets.find(b => b.dataset.cat === c.dataset.cat);
      if (bucket) place(bucket, c);
    });
    root.querySelectorAll('.w122-item').forEach(c => c.classList.add('w122-right'));
    root.querySelector('.w122-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w122-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  root.querySelector('.w122-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w122-item').forEach(i => pool.appendChild(i));
    root.querySelector('.w122-expl').hidden = true;
    unpick(); clearMarks();
  });
  ITEMS.forEach(it => pool.appendChild(makeItem(it)));
})();
</script>
```
